name: Sense
description: Bring every observation the sector can obtain into one governed, time-disciplined stream.

name: Ingest observations from every sensor class
Manage sensor readiness, modes, tasking, and calibration
Know sensor coverage and gaps over terrain
Receive early warning, tracks, and reports from peers
Understand
description: Turn observations into one honest picture with identities, uncertainty, and context.

name: Maintain one multi-sensor track picture with uncertainty
Keep tracks through gaps with visible quality
Track dense groups and count targets
Classify and identify with evidence and confidence
Keep one identity across gaps, sorties, sessions, and peers
Predict trajectory, time to impact, closest approach
Detect anomalies in tracks and feeds
Fuse terrain, imagery, point clouds, and map layers
Maintain pattern of life and order of battle
Decide
description: Turn the picture into a policy-checked recommendation for a human.

name: Score threat and priority per track
Act (recommend and authorize)
description: Put the recommendation in front of the person who holds authority, record what they decide, and hand off; never act without that record.

name: Never execute without a recorded human decision
Hand off to effector systems with provenance
Sustain
description: Keep the sector operating, learning, and honest over time and through outages.

name: Produce reports and measures from the journal
Report health honestly and run the alert lifecycle
Manage configuration baselines and mission plans
Secure
description: Control who can see and do what, and prove it afterwards.

name: Authorize by role, class, and layer
Protect data in transit and at rest
Integrate
description: Be one node in a system of systems.

name: Run as desktop, on-prem node, or cloud node
Operator
description: Runs the live picture for a domain at a site or the sector; decides engagements within delegated authority.

name: Supervisor
description: Runs the sector; manages the recommendation queue, weapons control status, holds, degraded-state acknowledgement, reconciliation conflicts, plan apply.

name: Analyst
description: Works the recorded record; replay, after-action review, reports, measures, model promotion evidence.

name: Sensor manager
description: Owns sensor readiness, modes, coverage, tasking, and calibration.

name: Administrator
description: Owns configuration baselines, accounts and roles, the node, and the audit record.

name: Intelligence analyst
description: Owns requirements and tasking, identification evidence and declarations, order of battle, pattern of life, dissemination.

name: Planner
description: Owns defended-asset list drafts, laydown and coverage planning, mission plans, rehearsal.

name: Commander
description: Holds the authorities the others act under; may decide directly.

name: Sector command post
description: The sector's command post; hosts the service node, the supervisor, operators, sensor manager, planner, intelligence analyst (vignettes, SCP).

name: Site defense cell
description: A defended site's cell with a desktop and local sensors and effectors (vignettes, OPS and HAF).

name: Port defense cell
description: The port's cell with a desktop, coastal sensors, patrol craft (vignettes, KAL).

name: Higher command
description: Sets rules of engagement; receives status, warnings, reports, order of battle.

name: Neighbouring sector
description: Exchanges tracks and warnings; hands over raids.

name: Fire units and effector systems
description: Receive decided assignments; report readiness and outcomes.

name: Sensor operators and maintainers
description: Operate and maintain sensors; modes, faults, calibration.

name: Civil aviation authority and airport
description: Corridors, flight plans, ADS-B; receive warnings of engagements.

name: Port and maritime authorities
description: AIS, harbour operations, barriers; receive warnings.

name: Coalition partners
description: Picture and product exchange with releasability.

name: Accreditors and auditors
description: Need evidence that the system enforces policy and records decisions.

name: Command-and-control system (Gungnir)
description: The logical performer that exhibits every system capability; realized by the desktop and the service node.

name: Operator workstation
description: The desktop (gungnir-app) with embedded or remote services.

name: Sector service node
description: The headless node (gungnir-node) that is the system of record in connected profiles.

name: Sensor network
description: The sensors feeding the sector, logically part of the C2 system's inputs; physical sensors are actual resources.

name: Effector interface
description: The handoff boundary to fire units and effector systems (CAP-4.4).

name: Ingest and validate observations
description: Bring sensor, cooperative, peer, and human reports in; validate; quarantine; carry provenance.

name: Maintain the track picture
description: Initiate, update, coast, and delete tracks from all sources with uncertainty and quality.

name: Identify tracks
description: Classify and identify from kinematic, signature, cooperative, and human evidence with stated confidence.

name: Assess threat and priority
description: Predict path, asset threatened, time to impact, closest approach; score against the defended-asset list.

name: Recommend assignments
description: Propose the cheapest adequate resource-to-track assignment within readiness, geometry, and policy.

name: Check policy
description: Evaluate identification criteria, weapons control status, authority, geofences, and restrictions; produce a verdict.

name: Decide
description: A human accepts, overrides, rejects, holds, or lets expire; the decision is recorded.

name: Hand off to effectors
description: Pass decided assignments to fire units and effector systems with provenance.

name: Warn assets and authorities
description: Warn defended assets, units, and civil authorities with lead time; record the warning.

name: Assess engagement effects
description: Track the engaged threat, record the outcome, supersede plans, re-plan the remainder.

name: Journal and report
description: Journal every event; produce summaries, reports, and measures after action.

name: Manage sensors and coverage
description: Set modes, task sensors, keep calibration, compute coverage and gaps over terrain.

name: Detect and correlate degradation
description: Detect sensor loss, ingest gaps, clock skew, quality collapse; correlate into incidents.

name: Re-task sensors
description: Change modes and tasking to restore the most valuable coverage; show before and after.

name: Exchange the picture with peers
description: Send and receive tracks, warnings, and products with peers, higher command, and partners.

name: Flag anomalies
description: Detect AIS-off, spoofing, loitering, and implausible feeds as alerts through the lifecycle.

name: State collection requirements
description: Express an information requirement with area, question, priority, and window; task or decline it.

name: Fuse identification evidence
description: Combine evidence into identities with confidence; retain the evidence with the track.

name: Maintain entities and order of battle
description: Keep global identities across sessions; merge and split; accumulate pattern of life.

name: Disseminate products
description: Release identities, warnings, and products to roles and peers with marking.

name: Set the defended-asset list and priorities
description: Define protected assets, priorities, and warning obligations.

name: Plan the laydown
description: Place sensors and effectors; compute coverage and gaps over terrain.

name: Configure policy
description: Set identification criteria, weapons control status, authorities, restrictions as geofences, delegations.

name: Validate and apply the plan
description: Validate a configuration baseline; apply it with audit.

name: Rehearse
description: Replay a scenario through the pipeline under a plan; review recommendations and gaps.

name: Review after action
description: Review the journal, measure, record lessons.

name: Operate disconnected
description: Fall back to embedded services; keep journaling; queue for forwarding; act under pre-delegated authority.

name: Reconcile journals
description: Forward the queue; merge local and node journals; report conflicts.

name: Resolve conflicts
description: Resolve reported decision conflicts under the arbitration rule; update the record.

name: Recommend a fires task
description: Propose a fires task with target location and uncertainty, time window, and deconfliction.

name: Manage the decision queue
description: Order pending decisions by priority and time remaining; apply delegation; escalate; time out.

name: Assist with questions and drafts
description: Answer questions about the picture and draft products with provenance and no authority.

name: Govern algorithm and model baselines
description: Validate, promote, and roll back the algorithm and model configuration in force.

name: Authenticate and authorize
description: Establish who a caller is and what their role permits before any action.

name: Audit
description: Record every decision, configuration change, promotion, tasking, and assistant exchange append-only.

name: Exchange cooperative identity
description: Receive IFF, ADS-B, AIS, and blue-force identity and attach it as evidence.

name: Tracking
description: Detections in, tracks with quality out; health honest (pipeline not implemented).

name: Intercept planning
description: Tracks and resources in, a PlanView out; last-good-plan on over-budget solves (allocator not implemented).

name: Event bus
description: Broadcast publish and subscribe with sequence-stamped envelopes.

name: Event journal
description: Append-only JSON-lines session journal; read back for replay; retention.

name: Time authority
description: Wall and replay clocks; source versus receipt time; late-data policy.

name: Configuration store
description: Load, validate, and save versioned configuration baselines.

name: Mission lifecycle
description: Create, live, save, load, replay, close a session.

name: Ingest gateway
description: Adapters behind a validating, authenticating, quarantining gateway (SourceAuthenticator, IngestGateway).

name: Sensor registry
description: Sensor records, modes with a transition table, coverage regions.

name: Interop catalogue and codecs
description: Schema catalogue with version negotiation; Arrow form; ASTERIX and STANAG codecs (NotImplemented).

name: Identity resolution
description: Global entity identity across session tracks with merge and split lineage.

name: Identification
description: Evidence fusion to friend, hostile, neutral, unknown with a margin rule.

name: Geospatial
description: Geofence containment, map layers, coordinate reference governance.

name: Analytics
description: Line of sight, viewshed, coverage volumes, route deconfliction over terrain.

name: Policy
description: Geofence and readiness verdicts through a chain that never self-approves.

name: Approval workflow
description: Pending approvals and decision records; nothing actionable without one.

name: Threat assessment
description: Risk scores and the reward matrix for the allocator.

name: Decision support
description: Rationale (real); alternatives and what-if (trait surface).

name: Model registry
description: Validate, promote, roll back algorithm baselines.

name: Authentication
description: Credential to OperatorId (trait only; mechanism D-02).

name: Authorization
description: Role-to-action matrix; unknown operators permitted nothing.

name: Audit log
description: Append-only audit entries per gated action.

name: API v1
description: Snapshot, event stream, detection submission, plan decision, health; transport pending.

name: Health monitor
description: Health snapshot from service flags; alert correlation; watchdog.

name: Store-and-forward and reconciliation
description: Bounded queue while disconnected; journal merge with conflict reporting.

name: Shared picture and arbitration
description: Apply node envelopes to a projection; role-rank arbitration of conflicts.

name: Operator workflow
description: Role workspace layouts; alert lifecycle; cases and annotations.

name: Replay
description: Deterministic playback of a journal under the replay clock.

name: Reporting
description: Reports and exports with every figure traceable to the journal.

name: Remote backends
description: RemoteTrackingService and RemoteInterceptService over the API with an outbox; transport pending.

name: Data loading
description: Point cloud, VTK, terrain, glTF loaders off the UI thread (surface only).

name: Point-cloud fusion
description: CPU reference and GPU ICP registration (trait surface).

name: Tracking metrics
description: MOTA, MOTP, purity, fragmentation against truth.

name: Scenario generation
description: The five engineering scenarios with truth.

name: gungnir-allocation
description: Bellman/DP resource-to-track assignment.

name: gungnir-analytics
description: Advanced 3D analytical functions -- line-of-sight, viewshed, sensor-coverage volumes, terrain masking, route deconfliction -- as standalone CPU services rendered by gungnir-viewport3d rather than embedded in it. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.3 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-api
description: Versioned, security-gated external contract (v1: snapshot, event stream, detection submit, plan decision) so remote desktops, peer C2 systems, analytics tools, or enterprise data services can integrate with a service node. Transport-neutral types here; the HTTP/JSON + WebSocket transport is the next stack addition. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.5 -- High.

name: gungnir-app
description: eframe desktop binary: bootstrap + AppState + update loop. The one crate allowed to depend on everything. Intentionally thin -- wiring, not logic, per rust-ui-architecture-coding-standards.md \u00a71. Selects the embedded or remote services backend from gungnir-config (ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a78) and runs eframe with Renderer::Glow so three-d has a GL context.

name: gungnir-assessment
description: Threat/risk scoring, predicted time-to-impact, asset exposure, confidence-aware prioritization feeding the allocation decision's reward matrix. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.4 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-association
description: NN/GNN, Hungarian/JV, gating, JPDA, MHT.

name: gungnir-collab
description: Collaboration & multi-user concurrency: shared operational picture across desktops connected to one node, concurrent annotations, and authority conflict resolution between operators' decisions. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.6 -- Medium. Server-authoritative mission state lives on the node (ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a78).

name: gungnir-command
description: Human-approval workflow sitting on top of gungnir-policy's verdicts -- the operator-facing accept/override/reject boundary for an intercept plan, with every decision recorded. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.4 -- Critical. Human-owned changes. Pairs with gungnir-policy.

name: gungnir-config
description: Managed, versioned, validated configuration for sensor definitions, filter/association selection, thresholds, allocation weights, backend selection (embedded or remote), and service-node settings. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.1 -- High. Pairs with gungnir-mission.

name: gungnir-coord
description: ECEF/ENU/NED/geodetic coordinate frame transforms.

name: gungnir-core
description: CV/CA/CT motion models -- F/Q generation (exact-match closed-form oracle only) -- plus the identifier, lifecycle-status, and PSD-assertion primitives every higher crate shares (docs/agentic-coding-standards.md \u00a71.2, \u00a72.1).

name: gungnir-data-fusion
description: GPU-accelerated point cloud registration/fusion (point-to-plane ICP) on wgpu compute, per rust-3d-data-ecosystem-build-vs-adopt.md \u00a73. The one genuine ecosystem gap identified -- kept as its own crate, separate from gungnir-data, because it's the only data-layer crate that needs a wgpu::Device (borrowed from gungnir-render).

name: gungnir-data
description: File I/O for point cloud / VTK scientific mesh / terrain / glTF, per rust-3d-data-ecosystem-build-vs-adopt.md \u00a71. No egui/three-d/wgpu dependency -- unit-testable with plain cargo test.

name: gungnir-decision
description: Course-of-action generation and comparison, constraint handling, what-if simulation against a live snapshot, and recommendation explanations -- beyond single-solution DP allocation. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.4 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-eventing
description: Transport-neutral broadcast event bus (in-process today; a durable/replayable log or network stream behind the same trait later). docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.1 -- High. Replaces the UI polling a mutable slice every frame.

name: gungnir-filters
description: KF/EKF/UKF/PF/IMM/sqrt-UDU/RTS state estimation.

name: gungnir-fusion-async
description: OOS handling / multi-rate async fusion pipeline. The only crate that uses the tokio runtime; the runtime is owned by the host binary.

name: gungnir-geo
description: Coordinate-reference-system governance, map/imagery layers, geocoding, vector features, spatial indexing, and geofencing. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.3 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-identification
description: Friend/foe/unknown track classification from an evidence-fusion process. gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.3 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-identity
description: Persistent global track/entity identity across feeds -- aliases, merge/split history, supersession -- beyond the tracking core's internal track IDs. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.3 -- High.

name: gungnir-ingest
description: Protocol-specific adapters plus a validation/authentication/quarantine gateway that normalizes live, recorded, and simulated sources into the canonical DetectionView before anything reaches the Tracking Service. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.2 -- Critical. Gateway changes are human-owned.

name: gungnir-intercept-service
description: App-facing facade over gungnir-allocation + gungnir-coord: turns current tracks + available resources into an intercept/tasking plan (gungnir-model PlanView). Kept separate from gungnir-tracking-service because it answers 'what should we do' rather than 'where are they' -- see ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a72.

name: gungnir-interop
description: Data standards & interoperability: the schema catalog with version negotiation, the Arrow representation of detections, and the ASTERIX/STANAG codec boundary that gungnir-ingest adapters and gungnir-reporting exports use. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.6 and \u00a71 (interop schema row) -- Medium.

name: gungnir-metrics
description: MOTA/MOTP, purity/fragmentation, track-to-truth assignment.

name: gungnir-mission
description: Mission/session lifecycle: create/load/save/replay/close, plus scenario binding. gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.1 -- High. Pairs with gungnir-config.

name: gungnir-ml
description: The model and feature-extractor traits learned models are held to, a fake model for the consumers' tests, and the dataset extraction from test-track sets into the Arrow form docs/ml/data-pipeline.md documents (GAP-077, GAP-079). OnnxModel, the ort-backed real Model, is real compiling code behind the onnx-runtime feature (off by default: agentic-coding-standards.md \u00a72.9, D-40) -- ort 2.0.0-rc.13's load-dynamic path panics rather than erroring when no compatible ONNX Runtime library is reachable, so it must not run inside default `cargo test`. ModelSet::load reports which named models are unavailable rather than pretending.

name: gungnir-model
description: Canonical, versioned operational data model -- TrackView/DetectionView/ResourceView/PlanView and friends, with provenance, quality, identity, timestamps, and classification as first-class fields. Foundational/Critical per docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.1 -- the service facades and every productization crate build on this one.

name: gungnir-modelops
description: Registry for selecting, tuning, comparing, validating, promoting, and rolling back filter/association configurations by mission profile, and (GAP-078) the model artefact -- name, version, hash, evaluation record -- a baseline optionally carries alongside its tracking configuration through the same promotion state machine. gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.4 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-node
description: Headless service-node binary for the on-prem and cloud profiles (ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a78.1): hosts the services layer and the authoritative gungnir-store journal behind gungnir-api. Targets Linux x86_64 containers; depends on no UI, three-d, or wgpu crate.

name: gungnir-observability
description: Production-facing metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, health checks, watchdogs, and alert correlation -- extends the developer-facing tracing instrumentation into an operator-facing system-status capability. gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.5 -- High.

name: gungnir-oracle
description: Differential-test harness against Python/MATLAB oracles. Depends on everything; nothing depends on it.

name: gungnir-policy
description: Authority model, geofence/no-go enforcement, and policy evaluation sitting in front of the Intercept Planning Service's output. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.4 -- Critical. Human-owned changes (agentic-workflow.md). Pairs with gungnir-command.

name: gungnir-remote
description: Remote implementations of the TrackingService and InterceptService traits that talk to a gungnir-node over gungnir-api, so the desktop switches between the embedded and connected profiles without any UI change (ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a78.2). Store-and-forward while disconnected.

name: gungnir-render
description: Shared wgpu device/queue/surface management + egui<->wgpu render pass wiring, per rust-ui-architecture-coding-standards.md \u00a71. No tracking-domain knowledge.

name: gungnir-replay
description: Deterministic session playback, timeline scrubbing, and recorded-data replay -- reads gungnir-store's event journal through a gungnir-time ReplayClockAuthority. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.6 -- Lower.

name: gungnir-reporting
description: Mission reports and export packages with provenance preserved: every figure traces back to the recorded event journal it was computed from. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.6 -- Lower.

name: gungnir-resilience
description: Resilience & disconnected operations: store-and-forward of envelopes while a node is unreachable, checkpoints, and journal reconciliation after the link returns (ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a78.4). docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.6 -- Medium.

name: gungnir-rfs
description: PHD/CPHD, GLMB/LMB random finite set filters.

name: gungnir-scenario
description: Ground-truth + sensor simulation, five-scenario generator. Test/bench dependency only -- never a normal dependency of a production crate.

name: gungnir-security
description: Authentication, role/attribute-based authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets/key management, signed binaries and configuration, audit logging. gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.5 -- Critical.

name: gungnir-sensor-management
description: Sensor registry (identity, modality, location, calibration version, operating state) plus tasking, mode management, and coverage planning. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.2 -- High.

name: gungnir-store
description: Durable storage for mission sessions (an append-only JSON-lines event journal), replay artifacts, configuration baselines, and audit logs, with an explicit retention/deletion policy. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.1 -- High.

name: gungnir-testkit
description: Shared proptest strategies for the tracking core. Depends on no workspace crate (so it can be a dev-dependency of every one of them without a dev-dependency cycle); nothing depends on it at runtime.

name: gungnir-time
description: Clock discipline across sensors: source-time vs. receipt-time semantics, late-data policy, deterministic replay-time control, synchronization health. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.2 -- Critical.

name: gungnir-track-fusion
description: Track-to-track fusion (CI/info-matrix), sensor registration/bias.

name: gungnir-track
description: Track lifecycle: init/confirm/coast/delete.

name: gungnir-tracking-service
description: App-facing facade over the tracking/estimation core. Owns the IMM bank, associator, track manager, and async multi-rate/OOS fusion pipeline behind one trait, and projects the core's kinematic Track into the canonical gungnir-model TrackView. See ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a72.

name: gungnir-ui
description: 2D egui dashboard panels + centralized theme, per rust-ui-architecture-coding-standards.md \u00a71/\u00a76. One file per panel; no magic layout numbers. Reads gungnir-model views only; holds no state of its own.

name: gungnir-viewport3d
description: three-d scene setup, camera, streaming/scientific data bridges, and live track/intercept rendering, drawn into eframe's OpenGL (glow) context. Combines rust-3d-data-ecosystem-build-vs-adopt.md \u00a72 with gungnir-model views -- see ARCHITECTURE.md \u00a74-5 for why track rendering lives here rather than in a translation crate.

name: gungnir-workflow
description: Human factors & operator workflow: role-based workspace layouts, the alert acknowledgement/escalation lifecycle, annotations and cases -- turning a set of panels into a designed operator workflow. docs/gungnir-capabilities.md \u00a75.6 -- Medium.

name: Gungnir canonical schema v1
description: The versioned JSON form of every view and event; the journal and the API carry it.

name: Apache Arrow (arrow 53)
description: Columnar form of detections for analytics and bulk exchange.

description: Cooperative air identity (GAP-010).

description: Textual and time-ordered form of GlobalEntityId (GAP-069).

description: Packaging of the service node for Linux x86_64.

description: Release evidence per docs/release-governance.md; exercised under GAP-061.

description: The framework these views follow.

description: The method plan 10 follows; references these views.

name: InterceptSolutionView

name: Provenance

name: Quality

name: Classification
description: Unknown, Neutral, Friendly, Hostile.

name: MissionTime
description: Seconds on the mission clock.

name: GlobalEntityId
description: Persistent identity across sessions (u128; uuid v7 under GAP-069).

name: Envelope
description: Sequence number, mission time, and one Event; the unit the bus carries and the journal stores.

name: TrackingEvent
description: TrackInitiated, TrackUpdated, TrackCoasting, TrackDeleted.

name: InterceptEvent
description: PlanProposed, PlanApproved, PlanSuperseded.

name: IngestEvent
description: Accepted or Quarantined with reason.

name: CommandEvent
description: ApprovalRequested; Decided with plan, accepted, operator.

name: ConfigBaseline
description: Versioned, validated configuration; sensors, resources, tracking, backend, node, horizon, data directory.

name: DecisionRecord
description: Who decided what on which plan, with verdict and time.

name: PolicyVerdict
description: Approved (never by built-in engines), Denied with reason, RequiresHumanApproval.

name: AuditEntry
description: Actor, action, time, outcome; append-only.

name: Alert and AlertLifecycle
description: Alert with severity; New, Acknowledged, Escalated, Closed with history.

name: SnapshotResponse
description: Schema version, tracks, plan, health.

name: ApprovalRequest
description: Plan id, accepted, operator.

name: SubmitDetectionRequest
description: One DetectionView for the gateway.

name: SubscribeRequest
description: The first frame of the event stream; from_seq.

name: SchemaEntry
description: Name, version, kind of a schema the build speaks.

name: SensorRecord and CoverageRegion
description: Identity, modality, location, calibration version, mode; coverage geometry.

name: Report
description: A mission report or export with figures traceable to the journal.

name: IdentificationEvidence
description: One piece of evidence with source and weight toward a classification.

name: RiskScore
description: Threat score per track with contributing factors.

name: ReconciliationReport
description: Merged journal statistics and the conflicting decisions found.

name: WorkspaceLayout
description: The panels a role sees, in order.

name: Mission and SessionId
description: A session with its state and configuration.

name: Operator workstation host
description: Windows 11 with a discrete NVIDIA GPU running gungnir-app; OpenGL context for egui and three-d; wgpu compute device for point-cloud fusion.

name: On-prem service node host
description: Linux x86_64 container running gungnir-node on the site or sector LAN; authoritative journal on local storage.

name: Cloud service node host

name: Observations from heterogeneous sensors are ingested through one governed gateway that validates and quarantines
Every source is authenticated before its data enters the picture
Sensor modes, tasking, and calibration are held in a registry and changeable by the sensor manager
Coverage is computed and coverage gaps are detected and displayed
Data from sources with different clocks is time-disciplined and skew is detected
Cooperative identity from open protocols is decoded and fused as evidence
A multi-sensor, multi-rate, out-of-sequence tracking pipeline maintains the picture
Tracks carry a quality and a staleness that the interface renders differently from fresh data
Classification and identification produce evidence with a margin rule and per-class thresholds set by policy
Entities keep a global identity with lineage across sources and sessions
Threats are scored against a defended-asset list with per-class lethality and asset weighting
The system recommends a cheapest-adequate assignment of resources to tracks within readiness, geometry, and policy
Every recommendation carries a rationale and its alternatives
The queue orders pending decisions by priority and time remaining, and supports pre-delegation where policy allows
A session is journaled, replayable, and reproduces the same picture
Measures are computed from the journal without manual collation
Shared types have exactly one owning crate; everything above re-exports
Every detection carries its source and its receipt time
Identification evidence names its producer, including model name and version for a machine-learning source
Envelopes carry a bus sequence number and a mission time
The node journal fsyncs every envelope; desktop journals fsync on session save and every five seconds
Journals merge in mission-time order, duplicates are dropped, and conflicting decisions are reported rather than resolved
Views, reports, and the interface contract carry a releasability marking
Training data and model artefacts live outside this repository; only the manifest enters it
The node exposes a versioned contract for snapshot, event stream, detection submission, and plan decisions
Schema versions are negotiated explicitly and an incompatible peer is refused, not silently accepted
Radar feeds decode from ASTERIX category 048
Each external party is a configurable endpoint with a message type rather than a bespoke integration
Detections are exportable in a columnar format for analytics and bulk exchange
No engagement, effector command, or reserved identity declaration executes without a recorded human decision
Authority is enforced per role, per class, and per engagement layer, per the authority matrix
Weapons control status is set by the authorized roles and constrains every recommendation
Pending decisions escalate and time out rather than waiting indefinitely
Every consequential act is attributable to a person, a role, and a mission time in an audit log
Machine identities authenticate with mutual transport-layer security; operator sessions use short-lived signed tokens
Data is encrypted in transit on every network crossing and at rest where the deployment requires it
The assistant has no tool that changes state and no dependency path to a crate that does
Untrusted text from sensors, peers, annotations, and reports is treated as data by the assistant, never as instruction
Every release carries a bill of materials, a signature, and its assurance reports
The desktop sustains its frame-rate budget with the 3D viewport open under a dense-swarm scenario
The per-frame tick stays inside its budget with ingest, poll, plan, and journal all running
Snapshot calls do not touch the pipeline and stay inside their budget
Detection to on-screen update stays inside its end-to-end budget in the embedded profile
The node sustains its detection ingest throughput through validation and quarantine
Detection to event-stream publish stays inside its budget on-prem and in cloud
An accepted envelope is durable within its budget, and the node recovers to serving within its budget after restart
A desktop falls back to embedded operation within its budget after link loss, stores and forwards to capacity, and reconciles within its budget
Covariances stay positive semi-definite and no value becomes non-finite over long runs
Each role has a workspace containing what that role's threads need and not more
Every layout carries a status strip stating what the system knows and does not know
Absence, staleness, and degradation are visible rather than inferred from silence
Machine assistance is labelled, sourced, and carries no authority in the interface
Default display vocabulary is the agreed standard terms, with a per-deployment override table
No dependency edge exists that `ARCHITECTURE.md` does not draw
Every dependency is recorded in the standards document \u00a72.9 and pinned once
No `unwrap()` or `expect()` outside tests, entry points, and debug-only invariant checks
Unimplemented capability returns a named error on every reachable path
The graphics and compute contexts stay separate and separately pinned
Deployment profiles differ by configuration and wiring, never by conditional logic in a domain crate
The two binaries contain wiring, not domain logic
No pass criterion or measure target is widened to make a test pass
Every artefact is unclassified and derived from public sources
No verification gate is waived by an agent
